\[
\gamma_\Lambda(I)(p) = \max \{ t : p \in C,\ C \text{ a component of } \{ I \ge t \},\ \Lambda(C) \}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(\Lambda\): The attribute test
- \(C\): A bright connected component of a threshold level
- \(t\): A threshold level

Threshold the image at every level t. Each bright component C of a level passes when its attribute meets the test Lambda, here an area or a diameter of at least the threshold. A pixel keeps the highest level at which it still lies in a passing component. Breen and Jones showed that an increasing attribute, one that only grows as a component grows, gives an opening. Area and diameter both grow with the component. scikit-image builds a max-tree of the components, after Salembier, Oliveras and Garrido, and checks each node once.
